product.name: Commercial Intelligence
product.description: A tool to score leads, automate RFP responses, and track competitor pricing to improve sales outcomes.

product.name: Competitive Analysis
product.description: A service to track emerging technologies, analyze clinical trials, and identify market white spaces for strategic insights.

product.name: RFP Generator
product.description: A tool that creates pre-filled, partner-ready requests for proposals (RFPs) for CROs, CDMOs, or funding agencies.

product.name: Patent & IP Intelligence
product.description: A service to monitor patent landscapes, conduct litigation analysis, and protect innovation pipelines in biopharma.

product.name: Scientific Literature Analysis
product.description: A service that connects scientific publications to market trends and identifies collaboration opportunities.
